bullets.text: The Velachery flyover project is in limbo after CMRL found integration unfeasible, so the office should monitor the Corporation to proceed.
Birders in Chennai recorded multiple white wagtails early in the migratory season at Pallikaranai, and the office should note this ecological milestone.

stories.title: Velachery Flyover In Limbo After Laying Foundation Stone
takeaways: The Rs 310-crore Velachery flyover project remains stalled as CMRL ruled out integrating the two ongoing infrastructure works together.
The Chennai Corporation can now proceed independently with the flyover construction after the transit feasibility review concluded.

stories.title: In 15 years, birders record multiple sightings of white wagtails in early months of migratory season
takeaways: Birders recorded multiple sightings of white wagtails early in the migratory season at Pallikaranai marshland.
Naturalists noted that rare migratory bird arrivals mark a positive ecological milestone for the protected wetland.
stories.snippet: Chennai: Birders have reason to rejoice this migratory season. For the first time in 15 years of observations, birders spotted more than five white wagtails in the early months of the migratory season at Pallikaranai.…
